environment.description: Staging deployment on EKS cluster behind identical infrastructure. LaunchDarkly project 'dashboard-staging' has the 'use-search-v2' flag with targeting rule: context key matching 'service:*' returns variation index 1 (True). Flag prerequisite chain: requires 'search-migration-complete' flag to also be True (which it is in staging since migration was validated there first). The flag's fallthrough is also set to True. Off variation is index 0 (False) but flag state is 'on'. Individual user targeting is empty. The SDK is initialized with the staging SDK key and the flag evaluation for context 'service:dashboard-api' resolves to True through the targeting rule match on 'service:*' prefix.
